title: The 1904 check counts the Forsyth house at 1635 Prairie
items: The 1904 scene's automated check holds, by name, the list of every building it places. The Forsyth house at 1635 Prairie went into the scene on 13 October without joining that list, so the check failed on every change since, and finished work could not be merged.
The house is now on the list. The check still fails if the 1904 scene places anything from the 1835 town, or anything else that is not on the list.
